We're a venture-backed company with offices in Australia, the United States, Belgium, Iceland, and the United Kingdom.
Â 
Join Secure Code Warrior and help us in our mission to create a safer digital landscape. Weâre empowering organizations to secure their softwareâno matter how the code is written!

We're looking for a self-starter to own revenue enablement for our global go-to-market team across the US, EMEA and APAC. You'll make sure every seller, BDR, sales engineer and customer success manager can explain what we do, run a sharp discovery conversation with a CISO or VP of Engineering, handle the tough objections, and win against the competition.

This role sits in Product Marketing, so you won't just run programs â you'll build the content yourself: product and competitive enablement, objection handling, onboarding and sales plays. You'll work within a small, fast-moving product marketing team where your work shows up in the field within days, not quarters.

What you'll do

Get the field ready for every launch. Turn new products and capabilities into talk tracks, demo paths, short videos and AI-driven self-training modules, so the field knows the story before customers ask.

Make discovery and objection handling a strength. Build discovery guides for the three people in every deal: the CISO or Head of AppSec, the CTO or VP of Engineering, and the Head of AI Governance. Keep a living objection library grounded in real calls, and run the practice that makes it stick.

Track the competition and find where we win. Follow competitor moves and market trends, mine win/loss data and call recordings, and bring that evidence to Product Marketing to sharpen our messaging. Build battlecards and sales plays backed by proof we can show a customer.

Build learning paths and certifications. Create role-based learning paths and certifications for AEs, SEs and CSMs, so everyone is ready before they pitch something new.

Own onboarding, globally. Run one onboarding program for every new GTM hire, from Sydney to San Francisco to Belgium. Set clear ramp milestones and keep making it faster.

Listen first, then build. Spend time with sellers, BDRs, sales leaders, SEs and customer success to understand what they actually need. Test drafts early, ask for feedback and iterate. Measure what gets used and what helps win deals, and retire what doesn't.

Show up at the big moments. Help shape enablement for Revenue Kickoff and product launches across all three regions.

Who you are

A self-starter. You see what needs doing and do it. You don't need a detailed brief or a big team behind you, and you're happiest building something from a blank page.

A collaborator who asks before building. You'd rather spend an hour with a seller than a week guessing. You ask for feedback early and often, you deliver what the team needs, and you never build in a vacuum and hand it down.

Decisive, with conviction. Listening doesn't mean building by committee. You know which feedback to act on and which to set aside, and you'll move on instinct with limited input rather than wait for consensus. Strong opinions don't knock you off course: you stick with what you know will work, and you say no, kindly and clearly, to what won't.

Crisp and clear. You can turn a complex technical product into something a seller can say in 30 seconds and a CISO will care about. You write tight and cut what doesn't earn its place.

Energized by pace. Our market moves every week. Priorities shift, new competitors appear, AI changes the rules. You find that exciting, not overwhelming, and you know how to ship something good fast and improve it later.

Curious about AI. You don't need to be an expert today, but you're excited to make AI part of how you work. We'll invest in your skills, and you'll help us figure out how AI can make enablement faster and better.

What you bring

6â9 years in revenue or sales enablement, sales engineering, product marketing or another customer-facing role at a B2B software company

3+ years in cybersecurity, application security or DevSecOps, with a real understanding of how CISOs, AppSec leaders and engineering executives evaluate and buy

A portfolio of enablement content you built yourself â talk tracks, demo scripts, battlecards, training â and evidence of what it changed

Experience building onboarding and discovery or objection-handling programs for Enterprise and mid-market sales teams

Comfort with technical topics: the software development lifecycle, code security and AI/LLMs

Experience enabling teams across time zones, with a strong instinct for content people can use on their own

Familiarity with a qualification methodology such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message, and tools like Salesforce and Clari

Nice to have

Competitive intelligence or product marketing experience

A background as a sales engineer or seller

Experience at a fast-growing company where you were the first or only person in your function

Why you'll like it here

Wide scope, real impact. You'll own enablement end to end and see your work change deals quickly.

A direct line to messaging. What you learn in the field shapes how SCW talks about itself.

Backup when you need it. You'll work alongside a Product Marketing team and SCW's AI Center of Excellence, which will help you build your AI skills and workflows.

A market that matters. AI is changing how software gets built, and security leaders need help keeping up. You'll be helping them do it.

Location

This is a remote role based in the US. We strongly prefer candidates in the Pacific Time zone, so you can work with teams in EMEA in the morning and APAC in the afternoon. Some travel for Revenue Kickoff and regional events.

You're joining us at an exciting stage of our journey, and youâre a key piece to what comes next. Expect real room to create impact and deliver on your ideas. The pace is quick and the bar is high; in return, you get genuine ownership and the kind of growth that only comes from building something that matters.

We also know you do your best work when you're rested and energized. Flexibility here runs on trust: we trust you to deliver when it counts, and we trust you to take the time you need to recharge. With teammates around the world, your hours can flex to fit your life, backed by generous leave and work-from-home options that help you make work work for you.

You'll join a tight-knit team that values humility and giving back, both to the community and to each other. Making the world a little brighter as we make it more secure is part of being a Warrior.

We live and work by the Warrior Code. It means getting feedback you can trust, shared without fear. It means no genius jerks: how you treat people counts as much as what you deliver. We do what we say we'll do, we celebrate the wins properly, and we do the right thing even when no one's watching. Come as you are, bring your best, and we'll do the same.

Strong information architecture and knowledge organization skills, with exceptional attention to detail and content accuracy. Understanding of data privacy, information security, and access control principles for AI systems, including human-in-the-loop approval processes and audit logging. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to understand business processes, collaborate with subject-matter experts, and translate operational needs into practical technical solutions. Familiarity with lead generation, marketing technology (MarTech), or data products is considered an advantage. Experience developing customer-facing knowledge bases, technical product documentation, or training content is a plus. Willingness to travel approximately 5â10% of the time.

title: Security Engineer, Offensive Security

Role Description

As anÂ Offensive Security Engineer within Dropbox Security, you will investigate how attackers could compromise our products and infrastructure, including AI-enabled applications and agentic systems. You will help identify meaningful attack paths and improve the controls intended to prevent, detect or contain them.

This is a hands-on offensive security and threat research role with broad scope and meaningful impact. You will contribute to investigations and multi-phase red team exercises, help prioritize work based on risk, develop attack techniques, and build tooling and automation that expand the reach of our security testing. You will apply practical AI security knowledge alongside broader offensive security skills across applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. Working closely with experienced researchers and partners across Product Security, Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Privacy, and engineering, you will help translate technical findings into clear business risk, recommend practical improvements, and validate their effectiveness through retesting. Sound judgment, clear communication, responsible execution, and ownership of your work are essential to the role. You will contribute to the Red Teamâs tools, research methods, and testing practices while developing your own areas of expertise, investigating emerging technologies, and helping advance Dropboxâs offensive security capabilities. You will have opportunities to deepen your skills, publish research, take on increasingly complex projects, and see your work influence security decisions across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes whatâs expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute offensive security assessments by defining objectives, scope, rules of engagement, and safeguards, adapting your approach as new evidence emerges.
  • Investigate unfamiliar applications, infrastructure, APIs, and trust boundaries to identify and trace meaningful attack paths.
  • Develop and safely demonstrate exploits and attack chains that clearly establish potential impact to Dropbox.
  • Build and improve offensive security tools, agents, automation, and testing harnesses, ensuring results are reliable, repeatable, and appropriately validated.
  • Assess security risks across AI-enabled applications, agents, tool integrations, and supporting infrastructure, including the responsible use of AI-assisted research techniques.
  • Partner with security, privacy, legal, and engineering teams to communicate risk, strengthen prevention and detection capabilities, address root causes, and verify improvements through retesting.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in offensive security, vulnerability research, red teaming or closely related security engineering, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • A track record of independently leading complex investigations or engagements and discovering and exploiting non-trivial vulnerabilities.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication and authorisation, cloud infrastructure, APIs and software supply chains, with deep practical expertise in one or more areas and the ability to trace attack paths across systems and trust boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience attacking or evaluating LLMs, AI agents, ML systems, AI-enabled applications, or agentic architectures.
  • Familiarity with security risks in AI-enabled applications, agents and tool integrations, and the ability to investigate unfamiliar technologies.
  • Ability to write code to build or adapt offensive tools and automation, and to read and investigate unfamiliar production codebases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing novel attacks, repeatable security evaluations or testing frameworks for AI-enabled systems, or building and validating AI-assisted offensive research capabilities.
  • Expertise across multiple attack surfaces, or advanced specialist capability in areas such as exploit development, reverse engineering, endpoint security, cloud exploitation or software supply-chain attacks.
  • Experience developing automated vulnerability discovery, fuzzing, program analysis or evaluation systems across large codebases or complex environments.
  • Experience conducting coordinated exercises with defenders to measure detection and response effectiveness and validate improvements against realistic attack techniques.
  • Contributions through original research, vulnerability disclosures, open-source tools, technical publications, internal training or mentoring.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

  • Operate production systems with actionable observability, incident response, dependency upgrades, backward-compatible interfaces, staged releases, and rollback paths.
  • Build secure analytical execution and data integrations with appropriate access controls, execution limits, audit trails, provenance, and reproducible artifacts.
  • Partner with scientists to turn validated methods into supported capabilities, preserving input requirements, diagnostics, uncertainty, and limitations through the API and agent experience.
  • Lead technical design and delivery within your area, coordinate with partner teams, review code and designs, mentor engineers, and improve how the team builds and maintains software.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying tool-using agents or multi-step LLM applications, with concrete understanding of context, structured outputs, orchestration, state, and model failure modes.
  • Experience designing and using evals to improve AI systems: representative cases, baselines, failure analysis, grader limitations, and quality criteria that influence what ships.
  • Practical experience with service reliability, authorization, queues or asynchronous execution, timeouts, retries, idempotency, and operational monitoring.
  • Working fluency in SQL and experience integrating data-intensive services or analytical tools; an ability to preserve data provenance and documented analytical constraints.
  • A record of leading substantial technical work with other engineers and partner teams, explaining tradeoffs clearly, and helping others contribute effectively.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with analytics agents, text-to-SQL, data discovery, notebook or code-execution environments, or internal platforms for data scientists.
  • Experience with agent evaluation harnesses, tool protocols such as MCP, model gateways, retrieval systems, or secure sandboxed execution.
  • Experience building reusable scientific libraries, packaging statistical methods behind stable APIs, or collaborating closely with scientists on validation.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and large-scale analytical data systems such as BigQuery, Trino, Spark, or Airflow.
  • Experience building product interfaces in TypeScript or React, or improving developer experience and adoption for a shared platform.

title: Lead Software Planning & Delivery (m/w/d)
description:
Bei Adlares machen wir Methanemissionen aus der Luft sichtbar – hochpräzise, zertifiziert und entscheidend für den Schutz kritischer Infrastruktur und den Klimaschutz. Mit unserem laserbasierten Messsystem CHARM® setzen wir den Industriestandard für die luftgestützte Gasfernüberwachung – und entwickeln aktuell die nächste, plattformunabhängige Systemgeneration (CHARM®3) sowie modernisierte Daten- und Auswerteprozesse im laufenden Betrieb.

Damit diese Neuentwicklung verlässlich gelingt, suchen wir eine Person mit hohen kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Du stellst sicher, dass wir unsere Softwareentwicklung verbindlich planen und zum Ziel führen. Du definierst gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement die Ziele, übersetzt sie in einen realistischen Plan und trägst die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung. So bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson im Planungsprozess.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ziele & Anforderungen: Gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement, dem Leiter IT und dem PO definierst du die Ziele der Softwareentwicklung. Du holst Anforderungen bei Operations, Laser- und Hardwareentwicklern und Nutzenden ein, erkennst Lücken und Widersprüche und übersetzt Deine Erkenntnisse in klare, umsetzbare Arbeitspakete für die Softwareentwicklung.

  • Planung & Kapazitäten: Du zerlegst Vorhaben in Epics und Tasks, planst Kapazitäten realistisch – inklusive Puffer für Betrieb und Tagesgeschäft – und machst Abhängigkeiten zu Hardware, Physik und Systemintegration frühzeitig sichtbar.

  • Umsetzungsverantwortung: Du sorgst dafür, dass Zusagen eingehalten werden: Du leitest das Daily, machst Fortschritt und Risiken transparent und steuerst nach, wenn etwas aus dem Plan läuft.

  • Entscheidungen herbeiführen: Offene Fragen bleiben bei dir nicht liegen. Du bereitest Entscheidungen vor, führst sie im Team oder mit dem Produktmanagement herbei, hältst sie fest und verfolgst ihre Umsetzung.

  • Architektur im Team: Architekturentscheidungen trifft das Team gemeinsam mit der IT-Leitung. Du moderierst diese Runden, bringst die Perspektive von Aufwand, Risiko und Planbarkeit ein und überführst die Ergebnisse in den Plan – auch bei der Frage, was wir am Bestand weiterführen und was wir schrittweise ablösen.

  • Mitentwickeln: Rund 20–30 % deiner Zeit arbeitest du selbst im Code, in Reviews oder an Prototypen. So kannst du Machbarkeit und Aufwand fundiert einschätzen.


  • Planungserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Planung und Steuerung von Softwareentwicklung mit agilen und strukturierten Methoden – idealerweise in einem Umfeld, in dem Software, Hardware und Messtechnik zusammenkommen.

  • Verbindlichkeit: Du schaffst Klarheit und Verbindlichkeit.

  • Teamgeist: Unser multidisziplinäres Team aus Physikern, Software- und IT Entwicklern, Konstrukteuren und Datenanalysten bringt 25 Jahre Erfahrung in Entwicklung und Betrieb von LIDAR Systemen mit. Du bindest alle Stakeholder in den Zielfindungsprozess ein.

  • Analytisches Gespür: Du ziehst aus Gesprächen mit sehr unterschiedlichen Beteiligten das fachlich Relevante heraus und erkennst Lücken und Missverständnisse früh.

description:

We're looking for a superstar candidate who can help the team to achieve new levels of success.


YOUR IMPACT

  • Own client relationships for a portfolio of large corporate accounts throughout the entire post-sale client lifecycle in Germany, leading all in-person and virtual client communications and meetings.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals. 

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration. 

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative and bold solutions to tackle challenges.

Who You Are

We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineering Manager with a demonstrated ability to lead and grow distributed teams of strong engineers working remotely around the world. You enjoy the pace of a growing company, stay close to what your teams are building, and help the people around you take on more ownership.

Our ideal candidates are passionate about building products that help engineering teams ship better software, faster. They follow closely how AI is changing the way software gets built, and they want to help Develocity lead that change.

  • Make the most of AI tools in your own work, and support your teams as they find new ways to build with AI

Minimum qualifications

  • Have managed more than one engineering team, working alongside team leads
  • The technical depth to serve as a partner to your engineers; you can challenge technical direction and identify risks early
  • Experience with a JVM-based product

  • Experience in leading and growing software teams and engineers

title: Machine Learning Engineer – Models in Production (m/f/d)
description:
Anyone can train a model in a notebook these days. Getting it into production, keeping it accurate month after month and turning its output into decisions people actually make is a different story. That's the job.

For a renowned automotive manufacturer in Munich, we are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who builds models that matter for a premium brand. You work with structured and unstructured data, take models all the way into production and make sure they keep delivering. Your results shape strategic decisions and the experience of customers who expect nothing less than premium.

What makes this role different

You don't build models that end up in a slide deck. You own them end to end, from the raw data to the deployed model to the insight a decision maker acts on. One client, one location, one team in Munich, with direct access to the people who use your work.

And you are the person who brings machine learning into the business. You explain what a model can and cannot do, teach colleagues how to use it and help them ask better questions of their data.

Degree or not, what counts is what you have built. If you have a proven track record of shipping machine learning applications, for example in open source, that is as valuable to us as a degree.

The goal is ambitious. Move machine learning out of experiments and into the decisions a premium brand makes every day, from strategy to the experience of its customers.

What you will do

  • Develop and implement machine learning models for premium automotive applications
  • Collect, clean and prepare structured and unstructured data so your models are built on something solid
  • Deploy models to production, monitor them and keep them performing over time
  • Turn results into clear insights that support strategic decisions and enhance the customer experience
  • Document your work and teach others how machine learning and AI can be used in their daily business

What you bring

  • A degree in a technical field with a strong focus on machine learning, or a proven track record of building machine learning applications, for example in open source projects
  • Outstanding Python skills and a real appreciation for clean, well documented code
  • Experience developing and running applications in the cloud
  • Hands-on experience taking models into production and monitoring them, ideally with MLOps tools
  • A genuine passion for machine learning and AI and their potential in real business applications
  • The ability to explain a complex topic to a manager in the morning and dig into a data pipeline in the afternoon

You'll stand out if you have shipped models that are used in day-to-day business, maintained or contributed to open source machine learning projects, or worked with automotive or industrial data.

Start on 1 February 2027 in Munich, 35 hours per week, with an engagement until the end of 2027. You will be employed by advanced engineering GmbH and work directly with our client's project team.

title: Occupational Health & Safety Expert , Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (f/m/d)
description:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

As Orbem’s appointed Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit, you are responsible for occupational health and safety at all Orbem sites and client installations, from laboratories and MRI environments to the workshop. You are the subject-matter expert Orbem relies on for the hard safety calls: you set the standards, build the systems behind them and lead the safety projects that matter most. You work with a high degree of autonomy. Your impact comes from technical depth, influence and mentoring. You decide independently on risk assessment methods, technical standards and corrective actions, align with management on measures with high cost or cross-team impact, and escalate imminent dangers and legal non-compliance early.

Your Day-to-Day

  • Legal Occupational Safety: You perform all duties of a designated occupational safety specialist under § 7 ASiG and ensure compliance with the relevant regulations (ArbSchG, GefStoffV, BioStoffV, StrlSchG, ArbStättV).

  • Safety Strategy & Systems: You own Orbem’s cross-functional OHS: risk assessments, incident management and compliance frameworks, including a legal register, standards, templates and escalation paths.

  • Subject-Matter Expertise: You are the key expert for safety in laboratory and MRI environments (magnetic fields, hazardous and biological substances) and set the standard for quality in this area.

  • Projects: You lead complex, cross-functional safety projects, such as new labs and build-outs, and coordinate contractor safety.

  • Incidents & Root Cause Analysis: You investigate incidents and near-misses, run root cause analyses and follow every corrective action through to closure.

  • Training & Mentoring: You build the training and instruction programme, document knowledge, give internal talks and mentor colleagues and the safety contacts in the teams.

  • ESG: Support the team with knowledge, advice and guidance on environmental and sustainability topics, and help develop how ESG fits into Orbem as the topic grows.

  • Authorities & Audits: You are the contact for authorities, auditors and external partners on specialist matters.

Your responsibilities include:

Keeping Orbem compliant with German occupational health and safety law, from risk assessments and training to incident follow-up and contact with authorities. You will also be focusing on the development of the OHS function at Orbem.

Your Experience and Skills

  • You hold the Sifa qualification under § 7 ASiG, on top of a degree in engineering, safety engineering or natural sciences, occupational health & safety or a related discipline.

  • 6+ years of experience in occupational health and safety, with proven depth

  • Strong knowledge of German regulations (ArbSchG, ArbStättV, GefStoffV, BetrSichV, BioStoffV,).

  • You have worked in laboratory or high-tech environments. If MRI and magnetic field safety is new to you, we will help you build that side.

  • A track record of leading complex, cross-functional safety projects and of setting standards and building systems, not only applying them.

  • You drive corrective actions to closure and win buy-in, not just the technical argument.

  • You have the standing to give independent advice and hold your position with management, engineers, and scientists, while staying pragmatic.

  • You share what you know: you document, train and mentor instead of becoming a single point of failure.

  • Although you work locally, you think across locations and see exchanges with colleagues at other sites as an opportunity to grow, both virtually and through occasional business trips.

  • Excellent communication in German (C1+) & English (B2+).

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Knowledge of electrical safety (VDE standards, DGUV Vorschrift 3)

  • Strong knowledge of StrlSchG

  • Experience with facilities in a deep-tech or high-tech environment.

  • Skilled at interpreting and adapting regulatory frameworks to ensure compliance in new geographical regions,

  • Experience with ESG topics such as sustainability reporting or a carbon footprint.

  • Knowledge of US requirements (OSHA)

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

  • We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

What We Offer

International Environment:

  • Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

Comprehensive Benefits:

  • Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

  • Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.

  • Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth.

  • Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

  • Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees.

  • Deutschland Ticket: Monthly subsidy towards public transportation costs.

Work-Life Integration:

  • Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you.

  • WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us!

  • 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge.

  • Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments.

  • Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year.

Make a Difference:

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.

Your Team:

You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/

At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway!

title: Finance Manager (Finance, Data & Automation) (gn) @ Atlantic, Berlin
description:
About Atlantic

Atlantic is the first believer in founders, science and bold ideas. We lead pre-seed rounds across Europe with speed and conviction, backing ambitious founders from day one and supporting them hands-on, especially with fundraising and hiring.

As a thesis-driven fund, we have built deep expertise in four technology areas: AI & Compute, Energy & Climate, Industrial & Robotics, and Space & Security. Since 2016, we have partnered with over 150 European founders in their earliest days, including those behind category-defining companies such as Choco, GetYourGuide, Wandelbots, Softr, Harmattan, Again, Synthflow and Mirelo.

For us, there is no 'too bold' or 'too early'. Just founders venturing into the unknown.

The role

As our Finance Manager, you'll run the day-to-day of Atlantic's fund finance: across portfolio monitoring, cash flow and invoicing, fund accounting and reporting, compliance, and special projects. You'll report directly to our Head of Finance and work closely with our Partners, our fund administrator and our tax advisor.

Beyond the day-to-day, you’ll have a clear mandate to automate. The goal is to cut manual work in half and let portfolio insights surface on their own. If building the finance function of a modern VC sounds better than maintaining one, read on.

What you'll own

Automation. You develop our existing setup, and automate finance and administrative workflows wherever it adds value.

Portfolio monitoring. You collect the reporting from our 150+ portfolio companies and use AI to turn the data into insights that the team can act on.

Cash flow and invoicing. You manage liquidity planning, management fees and invoicing across our funds and management company, and support capital calls and distributions.

Fund accounting and reporting. You review the work of our fund administrator and support the preparation of quarterly LP reports, annual financial statements and tax filings.

Compliance. You keep our funds and management company compliant, from regulatory reporting to KYC/AML checks.

Special projects. You take on ad hoc projects across finance, from new reporting requirements to supporting FX management.

The mission

Fast-forward - here's what you've built:

  • Half the manual work is gone. Processes that used to eat your week now run on their own, because you automated them

  • The portfolio talks back. AI pulls the numbers from 150+ startups, spots what's moving and puts it in front of the team before anyone asks

  • Portfolio reporting is an end-to-end system. One trusted source the whole team relies on

The moonshot: Automating the full path from term sheet to financial statements. Few funds work this way today. We want to be one of the first, and you'd be the one who helps us build it.

About you

You'll feel at home here if you:

  • Learned finance where the bar is high. Maybe in fund finance at a VC or PE firm, at a fund administrator, in Big Four audit or advisory, or in a strong controlling team. 

  • Know your accounting inside out, and enjoy putting it to work on a fund

  • Think AI-first. Claude is already part of your workday, and anything you do twice, you want to automate

  • Love turning data into insight, not just reconciling it

  • Own your numbers. You work independently, follow through, and double-check because you care

  • Roll up your sleeves. You're as happy running payments today as building the automation that runs them tomorrow

  • Are curious about startups, deep tech and the founders building them

  • Speak fluent German and English

Bonus points if you've worked in or around venture capital, or built your own dashboards, BI reports or no-code automations.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence | Working Student (m/w/d)
description:
Who Are We ?

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

💼 About This Role

As an Entrepreneur in Residence Working Student at CONROO, you will turn ideas into business opportunities and help shape the future of our company. Working closely with our founding team and Sales team, you will explore untapped markets, build new business areas from the ground up, and translate strategic ideas into actionable solutions.

🎖️What Success Looks Like

In your first month

  • You will collaborate closely with the founding team to explore new business opportunities and strategic initiatives.

  • You will conduct in-depth analyses and prepare decision-making frameworks for the founding team.

By 3 months

  • You will identify and evaluate strategic growth opportunities and untapped market potential.

  • You will develop innovative strategies and actionable proposals to improve our operations and expand our market presence.

  • You will oversee and optimize the execution of marketing campaigns, track performance metrics, and ensure alignment with business goals.

By 6 months

  • You will collaborate with the founding team to develop and launch new business areas from the ground up.

  • You will support cross-departmental initiatives that contribute to the company's growth.

  • You will continuously explore emerging trends and technologies to keep our offerings at the forefront of the logistics and IT sectors.

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful

  • You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Management, Information Technology, Logistics, Sales, Marketing, or a related field

  • You have relevant professional experience in entrepreneurship, business development, strategy, or project management.

  • You have excellent written and spoken skills in English.

  • You have strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.

  • You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • You take ownership of your work, and are motivated to take on responsibility and make a meaningful impact.

  • You continuously look for ways to improve the quality and efficiency of your work.

  • You bring a hands-on mindset, with a 'never-stop-learning' attitude and a desire to grow alongside the team

  • You take accountability for your tasks, follow through on commitments, and proactively address challenges.

This role is based in our Munich office, with at least 2-3 days per week on site.

🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful

At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

  • Onboarding sessions with your hiring manager, Felix, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.

  • Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.

  • HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.

  • Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür.

  • A buddy system during your first two months to help you onboard smoothly, get up to speed, and have a go-to person for questions.

  • Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.

  • We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

👥 About Our Team

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds who value ownership and continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way.

🤝 Why Us

💫 A mission that matters: Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind.

🏝️ Workation: Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days yearly working remotely from a different location, in line with our workation policy.

🎉 CONROO Time Off: Some moments deserve more than a celebration! Enjoy extra days off for special occasions like your birthday, wedding, or welcoming a new family member.

title: B2B Marketing Manager (m/w/x)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Du machst aus Content messbaren Impact. Mit durchdachten Automation- und Nurturing-Strecken, relevanten Newslettern und smartem CRM-Einsatz sorgst du dafür, dass Bring! Labs qualifizierte Leads gewinnt, Kontakte gezielt weiterentwickelt und langfristige Beziehungen aufbaut – entlang der gesamten Customer Journey. Dafür suchen wir, im Kontext einer Mutterschaftsvertretung bis Ende Januar 2028, eine:n B2B Marketing Manager (m/w/x) mit Fokus auf Marketing Automation & Growth.

Was dich erwartet

In dieser Rolle verantwortest du Marketing Automation, E-Mail-Marketing und Lead-Generierung mit klarem Fokus auf die FMCG- und Retail-Branche im DACH-Raum. Du baust in HubSpot automatisierte Strecken auf, die qualifizierte Kontakte gewinnen und gezielt weiterentwickeln, und setzt dafür passende Inhalte ein.

Marketing Automation & Lead-Generierung

  • Aufbau und Optimierung von Inbound-, Automation- und Account-Based-Marketing-Strecken in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Sales-Team
  • Planung und Umsetzung von E-Mail-Marketing & Newslettern in HubSpot
    Segmentierung, Lead-Scoring und Lead Nurturing, inklusive Reaktivierung bestehender Kontakte

Content & Formate

  • Mitarbeit an datenbasierten Branchen-Reports, Kategorie Insights, Success Stories und potenziell weiteren Content Pieces
  • Konzeption zielgruppenspezifischer Inhalte entlang der gesamten Customer Journey als Basis für Automation-Strecken und Newsletter

Performance & Optimierung

  • Analyse, Tracking und kontinuierliche Optimierung sämtlicher Maßnahmen entlang relevanter KPIs

Dein Profil

Bei Bring! Labs denken wir groß und suchen Menschen, die das mit Eigeninitiative, strukturierter Arbeitsweise und Teamgeist mitgestalten wollen. Wir freuen uns darüber, wenn du Teil unseres Teams werden willst und Folgendes mitbringst:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung in Marketing, Kommunikation, Wirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Marketing Automation, E-Mail-Marketing oder CRM, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung im Content Marketing oder Copywriting
  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Marketing-Automation- und CRM-Tools, idealerweise HubSpot (Workflows, Segmentierung, Reporting)
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Lead-Generierung und Reaktivierung von Kontakten
  • Starkes Verständnis für KPIs, Data Storytelling und Datenvisualisierung
  • Du nutzt KI-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT routiniert, um Daten auszuwerten, Content-Varianten zu erstellen oder Abläufe zu automatisieren
  • Kenntnisse der Media-Branche oder Erfahrung im Digital Marketing von Handel und Marken von Vorteil
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Warum wir?

Wir sind ein Tech-Unternehmen mit der Vision, die Kommunikation zwischen Marken und Konsument:innen neu zu denken. Bei Bring! Labs legen wir Wert auf eine professionelle und offene Arbeitskultur, in der unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Hintergründe willkommen sind. Wir bieten dir einen großartigen Arbeitsplatz, an dem du direkten Impact haben und deine Karriere weiterentwickeln kannst. Weiter bieten wir:

  • Ein attraktives und modernes Arbeitsumfeld im Herzen von Berlin, inklusive kostenlosem Barista-Grade Kaffee
  • Für deine Arbeit bekommst du das neuste MacBook/HP, inklusive Maus, Tastatur und hochwertigen Kopfhörern
  • Dein Geburtstag wird bei uns groß geschrieben. Daher hast du, ergänzend zu den 25 Tagen Urlaub, an deinem Geburtstag einen zusätzlichen freien Tag
  • Genieße die Flexibilität des hybriden Arbeitens: Treffe deine Kollegen in unserem Büro oder arbeite gelegentlich von zu Hause aus
  • Umweltfreundliche Reisemöglichkeiten, inklusive einer BahnCard 50
  • Wir lieben Social-Events: Alle 6 Monate treffen wir uns als gesamte Company in Zürich für ein geselliges Beisammensein. Die Reise inkl. Übernachtung wird selbstverständlich von Bring! Labs übernommen!

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich jetzt und beschreib uns in drei bis fünf Sätzen eine Automation-Strecke, die du selbst aufgebaut hast: Ziel, Auslöser, Ergebnis.

Willst du mehr wissen?

Wir berücksichtigen Bewerbungen unabhängig von Nationalität, ethnischem Hintergrund, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlecht, Behinderung oder familiärer Situation. Wir fördern auch die Bewerbungen von Berufsrückkehrern.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer, Internship

Open position, Berlin

Internship, 3 months

Location: Berlin (hybrid)

Start: January 2027, or as soon as you can

Format: Full-time internship, 3 months

Level: Bachelor, Master's or PhD student, or equivalent work experience

Who we are. Zeitgeist Labs is the applied research institute of the future in Berlin. Founded by scientists from Stanford, MIT, Max Planck and Charité with experience at McKinsey and in previous startups. This is a unique opportunity to join an early-stage company at its inflection point.

Problem we solve. Governments, foundations, NGOs and universities spend trillions every year on programs meant to improve people's lives. The industry that measures whether any of it works is slow and manual: months of fieldwork, hand-coded interviews, a 300 page report that lands 2 years after the program ends. The physical sciences are being accelerated by AI co-scientists. The social sciences are not, yet. In an age of ever-increasing complexity, we are building the tools that allow researchers to tackle the hardest scientific questions of our time: how societies work, and what actually changes them.

In short. You own problems end to end, working directly with the founders. Understand them, build the solution, test it, ship it. No ticket-passing.

What you'll do.

  • You work directly with the founders on the system our clients use every day. You own problems end to end: understand them, build the solution, test it, ship it. No ticket-passing.

  • Build and improve across the whole stack, from the research dashboard to the data layer to LLM output handling, every change shipped with a test

  • Build the architecture that turns thousands of data points, interviews, surveys and papers into insights

  • Extend how we collect data: interview agents, surveys, document ingestion

  • Run evals when a model or prompt changes and help decide what ships

How we work.

We are a human-in-the-loop AI company. Everyone here runs a fleet of agents; the human sets the direction, makes the calls and verifies the result. Claude Code is our daily driver, specs come before code, every change ships as a pull request with tests and docs. We care about creativity, critical thinking and solution orientation, not about knowing one particular framework.

Who we're looking for.

  • Self-driven: you have finished things on your own, a shipped app, a side project with users, a tool people actually use

  • Critical thinker: you question what you read, including what an agent wrote for you, and can explain why a solution is right

  • Wants ownership over comfort: small team, short path from your decision to the customer

Bonus points if you have.

  • Built a user-facing app in some flavour of JavaScript

  • Written and debugged your own SQL

  • Called, orchestrated, monitored and evaluated LLMs in something you built

  • A solid understanding of the German language

  • An interest in philosophy, sociology, anthropology, psychology, politics or behavioural sciences in general

Why Zeitgeist Labs.

  • Ownership of real problems from week one, and a piece of the architecture you can name on your CV

  • Daily work with the founders, hybrid in Berlin

About the interview.

  • First call with a founder

  • A small technical screen: a working session in our codebase, with your tools

title: Working Student Data & AI (m/f/d)
description:
About BetterDoc

We are BetterDoc, a digital health company with more than 200 employees in Cologne and Basel. We support patients with serious illnesses and complex diagnoses in finding the right specialists for their health concerns. To do this, we bundle, structure and analyze quality-relevant data from the healthcare sector. Since 2012, we have supported more than 100,000 patients. We have been part of the Otto Group since 2022 and work closely with our sister company Medgate, one of Europe's leading telemedicine providers.

You study medicine and are already exploring what AI can do? With us, you bring both together. You test prompts for real data requests, review AI outputs with your medical knowledge and help build small prototypes. And you see how they turn into products.

Our team

Medical Science is the medical core of BetterDoc. We turn medical knowledge into products: structured data, decision logic and, more and more, AI. Our physicians build prototypes themselves and take them live together with Product and Engineering. As a working student, you are part of this team.

We are looking for a working student (m/f/d) to join us as soon as possible, based in Cologne or remote.

Your mission

Day-to-day work

  • Maintain our medical database: Keep our medical database up to date through targeted research, structured data preparation and systematic validation.
  • Analyses and reporting: Contribute to analyses of medical data for internal decisions.
  • Improve processes: Help develop and automate the workflows and concepts around our database.

AI and prototypes

  • Develop prompts and prototypes: Write and test prompts and build small tools together with the team, for example with Claude, Python, SQL or Google Apps Script.
  • Review AI outputs medically: Assess the results of our AI applications, help build test and reference datasets, and find errors before they reach patients.
  • Structure medical knowledge: Turn medical information into structured data and classifications such as ICD, OPS and SNOMED CT.
  • Work with the product team: Bring your medical perspective to the development of our internal systems with Product and Engineering, and see how a prototype becomes a product.

Your profile

  • You study medicine and are enrolled at a German university, ideally in the clinical phase.
  • You have a soft spot for AI: You already use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor, and maybe you have even built something of your own.
  • Technical curiosity: First experience with SQL, Python or databases is a plus, not a requirement.
  • You are confident with spreadsheets in Excel or Google Sheets.
  • You work carefully, in a structured and precise way and keep track even of larger datasets.
  • Fluent German and good English.
  • You enjoy working in a team and also independently.

What BetterDoc offers you

  • AI tools and time to experiment – Work with modern AI tools such as Claude and Claude Code, with room to try out new ideas.
  • Learn from physicians who build – Work closely with our Medical Science team and discover a career path beyond the clinic.
  • Flexible alongside your studies – Your hours fit around semesters, exams and clinical electives. Remote work is possible.
  • Make a real impact – Help patients find the right specialists more easily.
  • A strong backing – Work for a successful digital health company, supported by Medgate and the Otto Group.
  • Further benefits – Office in the heart of Cologne (dogs welcome), team events, modern hardware, subsidized Deutschland-Ticket, Urban Sports Club contribution, corporate benefits and a company pension plan (bAV) with a 30% employer contribution.
  • For you and your family – Free access to BetterDoc and the Medgate video consultation service at any time.

description:

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

💼 About This Role

To make all this happen, we are looking for a Marketing Manager to work closely with our Founder & CEO, Felix, and take full ownership of marketing end-to-end — shaping our positioning and messaging while driving demand generation and measurable pipeline impact. As our first dedicated marketing hire, you’ll partner closely with sales and take on a central role in driving growth and commercial success.

In your first month

  • You will create innovative (content, tools, ect.) and highly efficient ICP based marketing campaigns.

By 3 months

  • You will create and manage key marketing assets, including landing pages, case studies, and sales materials.

  • You will plan and coordinate participation in industry trade fairs, and events.

By 6 months

  • You will build and run demand generation campaigns focused on qualified leads and pipeline impact.

  • You will own PR activities / Press alongside our global terminal and feature rollouts

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful

  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

  • You bring several years of experience in B2B Enterprise SaaS marketing roles

  • You have a proven track record of driving measurable impact on pipeline and revenue.

  • You bring experience in executing go-to-market initiatives, such as launching new products or entering new markets.

  • You are fluent in English and confident in communicating in professional business environments.

  • You are hands-on, pragmatic, and confident taking ownership as the first marketing hire in the company.

  • You are driven by innovative marketing approaches and continuously explore the latest trends, strategies, and growth hacks in B2B marketing.

This role is based in our Munich office, with at least 3 days per week on site.

🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful

At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

  • Onboarding sessions with your hiring manager, Felix, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.

  • Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.

  • We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

👥 About Our Team

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds who value ownership and continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way.

🤝 Why Us

💫 A mission that matters: Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind.

🏝️ Workation: Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days yearly working remotely from a different location, in line with our workation policy.

🎉 CONROO Time Off: Some moments deserve more than a celebration! Enjoy extra days off for special occasions like your birthday, wedding, or welcoming a new family member.

👊 Witness your actions shape our direction: You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible.

🏔️ Company getaway: Two annual team events where we work, unwind, and connect. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next?

🎟️ Employee discounts: Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more – online and in-store.

🌍 International team: With several nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together.

🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every time and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, talk to us! We consider support for courses, workshops, or other training opportunities.

Our Recruitment Process

  1. Application review

  2. Introduce yourself in a 30-minute call with our People Partner, Hind.

  3. Deep dive into your experience in a 45-minute interview with our CEO & hiring manager, Felix.

  4. Complete a take-home case study.

  5. Raise the bar in a 60-minute interview at our Munich office, where you’ll present your case study and discuss your experience further with our CEO, Felix, and COO, Ksenia.

We want our recruitment process to be accessible to everyone. If you need any adjustments to participate in an interview or assessment, please let our recruitment team know so we can discuss suitable arrangements.

title: VP of Sales, EMEA
description:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

This is the seat where EMEA goes from early traction to a real engine: you own the number, you build the team, and you stay close enough to the deals to feel every one of them.

What that looks like day to day

Our GTM team is growing quickly. In London we already have pods across Enterprise Sales, Commercial Sales, Customer Success, BDR and Solutions Engineering, with a mix of internally promoted and externally hired first-line and segment leaders in place.

You own the EMEA revenue number, including new business and the bulk of net retention across Commercial, Mid-Market and Enterprise. You lead the EMEA sales org directly, setting the bar on hiring, performance, coaching and territory design. You partner with in-region CS, SE, BDR and expansion account management to make the full regional motion work.

This is not a role you can do from behind a forecast. You'll be in the deals, running exec-level conversations with CTOs, CIOs and CISOs, inspecting and coaching pipeline personally, and carrying the deals that need you. You'll also drive operational excellence across pipeline reviews, forecast calls, QBRs, recruiting, enablement, fiscal planning and territory design.

Our leaders are close to the product, close to customers, and close to cross-functional peers. You'll work closely with our founders, COO, CMO, VP Finance, RevOps and Product, and build trust with Engineering, Marketing, Finance and company leadership. What you hear in region should influence the roadmap, and you'll contribute to company-wide planning and exec discussions, helping shape our global growth trajectory.

We want a real point of view on AI in GTM. How your team prospects, researches, qualifies, forecasts and closes should look different because of it.

You also set the cultural tone in London: a high performance bar, and a culture people want to be part of.

Who you are

  • You're based in or around London, and you're up for travelling across EMEA and occasionally to the US.

  • You've built an EMEA revenue engine from roughly $XXM to $XXXM at a high-growth B2B software company, and you have the appetite and resilience to take us from early traction to sustained scale in a Series B environment.

  • You've built and scaled sales teams across Commercial, Mid-Market and Enterprise, and you know how the motion, hiring bar and cadence differ across each.

  • You're hands-on. You still get into deals, run discovery, coach live calls and hold a point of view on the product. You're not two layers removed from the customer.

  • You understand technical sales and have a track record selling to CTOs, CIOs and CISOs.

  • You have a real point of view on leveraging AI in GTM, grounded in things you've actually rolled out rather than things you've read about.

  • You keep a high performance bar while building a culture aligned with our values. We want both, and candidates who can only do one are not a fit. You're also an exceptional recruiter who attracts and retains A-players, and people follow you.

  • You build trust extensively across Engineering, Product and company leadership, and you're operationally excellent, with a bias for clarity, measurement and predictable execution.

Bonus points if you have experience scaling footprint into other European markets such as France, DACH and the Nordics. VP of EMEA Sales experience at a high-growth SaaS company scaling from $XXM to $XXXM+ is a plus, as is senior regional leadership at a $10B+ B2B software company with material revenue responsibility. We'd also love experience selling to engineering and SRE buyers in the reliability, observability, monitoring or DevOps space, early channel and alliances go-to-market experience, and the ability to lead cross-cultural teams across Europe.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform team and help us build reliable software for a complex, real-world AI product.

The Platform team works across a broad range of problems at Gigaton, from CI/CD for our monorepo and networking and data integration with on-premise plant systems, to hardening our IoT OS image and building customer-facing software around our control systems.

The work is currently split across two squads:

  1. Enablement, focused on helping engineers move faster.

  2. Product, focused on supporting our control software.

Whichever squad you join, you’ll work across technically challenging problems with plenty of scope to learn, contribute and shape how we build software.

Your main responsibilities

  • Write reliable, well-tested software in Python and Terraform.

  • Monitor, support and improve software running in production.

  • Mentor less experienced engineers and help them develop their craft.

  • Identify, articulate and drive architectural improvements.

  • Bring strong software engineering practices to code developed across the wider engineering and ML teams.

  • Contribute to improving the quality, maintainability and reliability of our systems.

Bonus experience

You don’t need all of these, but experience in any of the following would be useful:

  • Control engineering, machine learning or MLOps.

  • AWS IoT, Greengrass or Mender for managing device fleets.

  • Working across multiple cloud environments, such as AWS, GCP or Azure.

  • Managing CI/CD environments using GitHub Actions.

  • Building production artefacts using tools such as Docker.

  • Functional programming languages such as Haskell, F# or Elm.

  • Building or working with more complex AI-enabled workflows beyond simple prompting.

You’ll excel if you are

  • Excited by complex technical domains and enjoy getting to grips with unfamiliar systems.

  • Highly collaborative and comfortable working across software, ML and other disciplines.

  • Familiar with practices such as testing, pairing, mobbing and iterative software development.

  • Pragmatic about engineering trade-offs and know when good enough now is better than perfect later.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving requirements.

  • Able to improve existing systems, not just build new ones from scratch.

  • Happy to take ownership of problems and follow them through into production.

💡 You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match.

We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from different countries, cultures and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you.

The interview process

Our interview process is designed to help us understand your experience, how you think and how you work with others, while giving you plenty of opportunity to get to know Gigaton too.

1. Talent Partner conversation

You’ll start with a conversation with our Talent Partner. We’ll talk through your background, what you’re looking for and what interests you about Gigaton.

We’ll also give you more context on the role, the team and the interview process, and answer any initial questions you have.

2. Hiring Manager interview

Next, you’ll meet the hiring manager for a deeper conversation about your experience and some of the technical problems you’ve worked on.

We’ll explore the work you’ve owned, the decisions you’ve made, how you approach engineering trade-offs and whether the role feels like a strong match on both sides.

3a. Pair Programming - remote session

You’ll work with one of our engineers on a small technical exercise using Python and Terraform.

We’re not assessing memorised syntax or speed under pressure. We’re interested in how you reason, collaborate, use tests to guide your work, learn from documentation or tools, and communicate while solving an unfamiliar problem.

3b. Technical Onsite

This technical stage takes place in our London office and consists of one session.

System design

You’ll walk us through a real system you’ve worked on and had meaningful influence over.

We’ll ask about the problem, constraints, operational characteristics, design decisions, trade-offs and how the system evolved over time.

This isn’t a formal presentation. You’ll introduce the system for around 10–15 minutes, then we’ll explore it together in more depth.

4. Operating Principles interview

We’ll discuss examples from your past experience that relate to how we work at Gigaton:

  • Concrete Honesty

  • Autonomous Ownership

  • Go Gig or Go Home

  • Cement It with Fun and Kindness

We’re interested in specific examples of how you’ve demonstrated these behaviours in practice rather than abstract culture-fit questions.

5. CEO conversation

Finally, you’ll meet Josh, our CEO.

This is a chance to talk more broadly about Gigaton, our mission, where the company is heading and whether this feels like the right move for both sides.

We believe hiring is a two-way process. Just as we’ll conduct reference checks before making a final offer, we encourage you to reference-check us too by speaking with team members you haven’t yet met.

Once interviews are complete, we’ll move quickly to a decision, and we’re always happy to provide feedback at any stage.

In return for your hard work, we’ll give you

📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside.

🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

Our Operating Principles

↗️ Go Gig or Go Home: High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires.

🏭 Concrete Honesty: Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture.

🦾 Autonomous Ownership: High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it.

😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun: Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page.

Compensation: £60K – £105K • Multiple Ranges

  • Mid Level • £60K – £85K

title: Senior Account Executive, Strategic Pod
description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Sales team

Sales at hx is driving exceptional growth in one of the world’s most complex industries, partnering with globally recognised insurers including Aviva, Markel, Munich Re, Beazley, and others across EMEA and the US. This is where AI, SaaS, and specialty insurance converge, and where we help leading insurers transform how they underwrite and price risk.

Our Strategic Sales team works on the largest and most complex opportunities at hx: multi-year, seven-figure partnerships that sit at the centre of our customers’ underwriting and pricing transformation. These deals involve long, high-touch sales cycles and require you to win the trust of actuaries, underwriters, IT leaders, and C-suite executives.

This is not transactional sales. The people who thrive here take ownership of ambiguity, build deep credibility with customers, and solve problems others can’t. They move seamlessly between strategy and execution, shaping how enterprise insurers adopt and scale AI-powered decision-making.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own and execute a strategic territory plan across the UK and EMEA, building and closing a pipeline of high-value opportunities with enterprise insurers in your named accounts.

  • Consistently deliver and exceed enterprise revenue targets by closing seven-figure, multi-year partnerships that become long-term, strategic relationships rather than one-off wins.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders including C-suite, actuarial, underwriting, and technology leaders, positioning hx as a long-term transformation partner rather than a point solution.

  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with structure and discipline, qualifying deeply, managing risk, and maintaining control from first conversation through to close and handover.

  • Orchestrate cross-functional teams across pre-sales, product, professional services, and leadership to deliver cohesive, high-impact engagements that move deals forward and set customers up for successful adoption.

  • Represent hx in the market and build enduring customer relationships, using industry events, executive forums, and ongoing account engagement to unlock additional value for clients and support hx’s long-term growth and category leadership.

What you’ll need to have done

  • Sold B2B SaaS in complex, enterprise environments, ideally into regulated, technical, or analytical buyer groups such as financial services or insurance.

  • Consistently delivered against enterprise-level quotas, with a proven track record of closing multi-year, high-value new business deals and driving expansion within strategic accounts.

  • Led structured, rigorous sales processes using methodologies such as MEDDICC, Challenger, or similar, and can point to specific deals where this discipline helped you qualify deeply, manage risk, and keep control of long cycles.

  • Built credibility with senior stakeholders, including C-suite, actuarial, underwriting, and technology leaders, by demonstrating depth of understanding, sound commercial judgement, and an ability to navigate complex organisations.

  • Operated in long, high-touch, multi-stakeholder sales cycles where success depended on education, alignment, and trust, translating complex technology and abstract value into clear commercial outcomes.

  • Owned a territory with care and discipline, using tools like Salesforce for accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and planning, and demonstrating an ownership mindset in how you drive outcomes.

How we build in an AI-forward company

hx is a maximally AI-forward company because we believe AI should amplify what exceptional people can achieve. Everyone here is a builder. That means staying close to what’s changing, continuing to learn, and using AI to raise the quality, pace and ambition of your work.

We expect everyone to actively experiment with AI and agentic systems, whether at work or in their personal lives. This means going beyond prompting, exploring what agents can do autonomously, and learning by doing. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to be curious, hands-on and willing to push what's possible.

Your current environment is context, not the answer. We’re interested in how you think about what should be possible now, not simply how things are done where you work today. We care about judgement, creativity and ownership, not simply using more tools.

The bar is simple: your work should be meaningfully better because of how you operate in this new world.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual well-being allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

Additional Perks:

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular hackathons, lunch & learns, and socials, both remote and in-person, to foster collaboration and creativity.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, fully stocked snacks and drinks, and a fun, creative office at The Ministry.

  • Access to cutting-edge AI tools and an experimentation budget, giving you the freedom to test, learn, and innovate ahead of the market.

Interview Process

  • Talent Partner Screen - 30 minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 45 minutes

  • Deal Creation and Closing Presentation - 90 minutes

  • Values interview + Meet the CEO - 90 minutes

  • Meet the CRO - 30 minutes

  • We offer!

Our Commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Exceptional technical storytelling. You can take a complex research breakthrough and explain why it matters without exaggeration or jargon. You’re equally comfortable writing a technical launch post, challenging an evaluation methodology, and presenting a competitive argument to an enterprise CTO.

Strong judgment and independent execution.
