description:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent.

We're a 180+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites, with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far.

We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.

The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

Learn more about us on our website.

🚀 The Role

We're hiring Product Engineers at Staff, Senior Staff, and Principal level across three of our engines: Buy, Sell and Third Party Access (TPA).

A Product Engineer at tem gets handed a problem, not a ticket. You sit inside an engine, next to the account managers, partners and customers who live with the problem. You work out what to build, build it, and stay with it after launch until you can show it moved the metric. Product sets the bet and the guidance, not the feature list, so nobody writes your tickets for you.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a people-management one. We will talk to you about which engine fits you best, and where your experience and interests line up.

Buy: Buy is where businesses pay less for clean power. It's the side of tem that runs RED for the UK businesses on it: quotes with every cost up front, bills itemised line by line, and a switch from quote to live in minutes, not days. You'd build the products and systems behind that, from tender to signed contract to a bill with nothing to hide, and make it work just as well for the next thousand sites as it does for the first.

Sell: Sell is where generators earn more for what they produce. We contract with UK solar, wind, hydro, anaerobic digestion, biomass and EfW sites, from single farms to multi-site portfolios, through broker partners and direct. You'd build the tools that get generators signed faster, show them exactly what they're earning, and get them paid on time, every time. You'd also open up new kinds of sites we can't contract today, so there's more clean power to put in front of businesses.

Third Party Access (TPA): TPA builds the new transaction rails for our partners. It lets brokers, banks, affiliates and generators sell tem's energy under their own brand, running on Rosso, our pricing engine. You'd design and build the partner APIs, branded portals, billing and settlement that make that work, and take a 0 to 1 product from pilot to production. In TPA you'll also be partner-facing, embedding with partners to get them integrated and live.

📆 In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Sit with the account managers, partners and customers in your engine, run discovery calls yourself and turn what you hear into a clear problem to solve.

  • Decide what to build and what to leave out, then design and ship it without waiting for a spec.

  • Ship work that moves a named business metric, and stay with it until you can show the number moved.

  • In TPA, help take partner integrations from pilot to production, live and working.

  • Mentor engineers around you and share what you learn with teams across the business.

🛠️ Responsibilities

  • Own discovery: Work directly with the commercial team, partners and customers to find the real problem, proactively engaging them and running calls autonomously.

  • Turn problems into outcomes: Turn subjective requirements into objective outcomes, deciding what to build, then designing and shipping it yourself.

  • Be accountable for the number: Take full accountability for the business and user metrics that move as a direct result of your technical and customer work.

  • Own it end to end: Stay with it after launch and make sure it moves what it was meant to move within the business.

  • Make the hard calls: Make sound but critical judgement calls on speed versus robustness, and on commercial risk.

  • Spread what you learn: Feed what you learn from partners and customers back into the product, with an impact across departments that aren't your own.

  • Raise the bar: Mentor engineers around you and raise technical standards, helping others accelerate into roles you used to hold.

✅ Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Proven technical leadership at Senior, Staff or Senior Staff level, with genuine, statistical evidence of leading complex, ambiguous work to real business impact.

  • Comfort operating without a spec, with several clear-cut examples of how you went against the status quo or ran without guidelines to deliver something impactful.

  • Sound commercial judgement, including an understanding of the revenue impact of the risks you take and whether a headcount investment outweighs its costs.

  • Comfort being the technical voice in front of commercial stakeholders and partners, from our leadership team through to our board members and investors.

  • A hands-on, player-coach approach, and comfort in our stack: Python, TypeScript, AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EventBridge) and event-driven architectures.

Desirable

  • Forward-deployed, solutions or customer-facing engineering experience.

  • API, integration and multi-tenant or white-label platform design, which is especially useful for TPA.

  • Experience taking a 0 to 1 product into production.

🎁 Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. Véritable manager de proximité, vous coordonnez les équipes et les moyens techniques afin de garantir la performance des installations, la conformité réglementaire et la préservation de l'environnement.

  • Participer à l'amélioration continue des installations et à leur modernisation.

  • Contribuer aux projets de travaux neufs, de réhabilitation et de modernisation des ouvrages. 

  • Veiller au maintien en bon état des équipements électromécaniques, hydrauliques et d'automatisme. 

Autosurveillance et conformité réglementaire 

  • Garantir le respect des programmes d'autosurveillance. 

  • Superviser le suivi métrologique des équipements de mesure. 

  • Veiller à la fiabilité des données remontées par les outils de supervision. 

  • Préparer et accompagner les audits ainsi que les contrôles des organismes réglementaires (Police de l’Eau). 

  • Assurer le suivi et le traitement des non-conformités. 

Automatisme, supervision et télégestion

title: Stage M2 : Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales
description:
Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales

Organisme d’accueil : Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) – IMT Mines Albi

Le Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) développe des activités d’enseignement et de recherche autour de la modélisation, du pilotage et de l’amélioration des systèmes industriels et organisationnels, dans des contextes complexes et incertains (industrie du futur, supply chain, résilience, etc.).

Contexte et missions

Les inégalités territoriales d’accès aux soins constituent un enjeu majeur des politiques publiques de santé en France. Elles sont particulièrement marquées dans les territoires ruraux et isolés, caractérisés par une faible densité de population, des distances importantes aux services de santé et une démographie médicale parfois fragile. Dans ces territoires, l’amélioration de l’accès aux soins ne repose pas uniquement sur l’augmentation du nombre de professionnels de santé, mais également sur leur localisation et leur organisation territoriale.

Dans le cadre du projet de recherche MAillage Territorial pour Améliorer l’Accès aux soins dans les zones Rurales et Isolées (MATAARI), l’objectif est de développer des méthodes d’optimisation permettant de concevoir de nouvelles organisations territoriales de l’offre de soins, en tenant compte des contraintes géographiques, démographiques et médicales.

Les indicateurs actuellement utilisés pour caractériser l’accès aux soins, notamment l’Accessibilité Potentielle Localisée (APL) développée par la DREES [1], permettent de prendre en compte simultanément la demande de soins, l’offre médicale et la distance entre les populations et les professionnels de santé. Aujourd’hui, ces indicateurs sont principalement utilisés à des fins de diagnostic et de caractérisation des territoires. L’enjeu de ce stage sera de les intégrer dans un problème d’optimisation afin de déterminer les conditions nécessaires à l’amélioration de l’accessibilité aux soins.

Le stage constituera ainsi une première étape consacrée à la localisation optimale de professionnels de santé, avant une intégration ultérieure de ce problème dans les modèles de districting développés dans le cadre de MATAARI.

Dans un premier temps, le.la candidat.e développera un modèle de Facility Location Problem (FLP) intégrant notamment l’offre et la demande de soins, les indicateurs d’accessibilité, les spécificités territoriales et sociales, qui pourront être éclairées par les travaux de l’équipe interdisciplinaire en sciences humaines et sociales travaillant également sur le projet. Une attention particulière sera portée à la non-linéarité du problème.

Dans un second temps, le modèle de localisation sera adapté dans une perspective d’intégration au problème de districting territorial développé dans le projet MATAARI. Il s’agira d'identifier comment les décisions de localisation de l’offre médicale peuvent être intégrées aux décisions de découpage du territoire afin de construire un modèle hiérarchisé ou intégré.

L’objectif final est ainsi de disposer d’un modèle de localisation autonome pouvant constituer un module d’optimisation de l’offre de soins, intégrable ultérieurement aux modèles de maillage territorial développés par les autres acteurs du projet.

État de l’art

Les problèmes de localisation d’infrastructures (Facility Location Problems) constituent une famille classique de problèmes de recherche opérationnelle visant à déterminer l’implantation optimale d’un ensemble d’infrastructures afin de répondre à une demande distribuée spatialement [2], [3]

De nombreuses variantes ont été développées, notamment les problèmes de p-median, set covering, maximal covering location problem et capacitated facility location. Ces modèles ont été largement mobilisés dans le domaine de la santé pour étudier l’implantation d’hôpitaux, de centres de soins ou de professionnels de santé [4], [5]

Dans le contexte médical, les modèles de localisation doivent toutefois intégrer des caractéristiques spécifiques : demande hétérogène, capacité limitée des professionnels, accessibilité spatiale, distances maximales, concurrence entre sites et incertitude sur l’offre médicale. Une réflexion sur la définition et la mesure de l’accessibilité permettra de proposer une modélisation plus fine des interactions entre la localisation de l’offre de soins, les distances et les besoins des populations. Le problème étudié dans le cadre de ce stage se situe ainsi à l’intersection des problèmes de localisation, des problèmes d’accessibilité spatiale et des problèmes d’organisation territoriale des soins.

Une seconde dimension concerne le lien avec les problèmes de districting et de territory design [6], [7].

Alors que ces derniers cherchent principalement à construire des territoires cohérents sous différentes contraintes géographiques et démographiques, le couplage avec un problème de localisation permet d'introduire explicitement la question de l'organisation de l'offre de soins au sein de ces territoires.

Ce couplage constitue une étape importante vers le développement d'un modèle de maillage territorial adapté aux spécificités des zones rurales.

Profil recherché

Nous cherchons un.e candidat.e en M2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs, spécialisé.e en Recherche Opérationnelle, Optimisation Combinatoire, Informatique ou domaine connexe.

Compétences attendues :

  • Formalisation de problèmes complexes (PL, PLNE)

  • Compétences solides en algorithmique et programmation (de préférence Python)

  • Bonnes capacités rédactionnelles en français et en anglais pour la documentation et la communication des résultats

Modalités

Date de début : à partir de février 2027 (flexible)

Durée : 5-6 mois

Laboratoire : Centre Génie Industriel, IMT Mines Albi.

Lieu : Albi

Contact

Pour toute question concernant le stage, contactez Cléa Martinez ----- candidater, envoyez votre CV, lettre de motivation, et notes de master à Cléa Martinez (

Références

[1] M. Barlet, « L’Accessibilité potentielle localisée (APL) : une nouvelle mesure de l’accessibilité aux soins appliquée aux médecins généralistes libéraux en France », Etudes et recherche 124, 2012.

[En ligne]. Disponible sur: https://drees.solidarites-sante.gouv.fr/sites/default/files/2020-10/dter124.pdf

[2] C. S. ReVelle, H. A. Eiselt, et M. S. Daskin, « A bibliography for some fundamental problem categories in discrete location science », European Journal of Operational Research, vol. 184, no 3, p. 817‑848, févr. 2008, doi: 10.1016/j.ejor.2006.12.044.

[3] Z. Drezner et H. W. Hamacher, Facility Location: Applications and Theory. Springer Science & Business Media, 2004.

[4] W. Gu, X. Wang, et S. E. McGregor, « Optimization of preventive health care facility locations », Int J Health Geogr, vol. 9, no 1, p. 17, mars 2010, doi: 10.1186/1476-072X-9-17.

[5] A. Ahmadi-Javid, P. Seyedi, et S. S. Syam, « A survey of healthcare facility location », Computers & Operations Research, vol. 79, p. 223‑263, mars 2017, doi: 10.1016/j.cor.2016.05.018.

[6] J. Kalcsics et R. Z. Ríos-Mercado, « Districting Problems », in Location Science, G. Laporte, S. Nickel, et F. Saldanha da Gama, Éd., Cham: Springer International Publishing, 2019, p. 705‑743. doi: 10.1007/978-3-030-32177-2_25.

[7] S. Yanık et B. Bozkaya, « A Review of Districting Problems in Health Care », in Optimal Districting and Territory Design, R. Z. Ríos-Mercado, Éd., in International Series in Operations Research & Management Science. , Cham: Springer International Publishing, 2020, p. 31‑55. doi: 10.1007/978-3-030-34312-5_3.

Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…).

Le poste

En tant que Support Operations Specialist, tu rejoindras la Team Customer Success & Delivery. Véritable point de contact de nos clients, tu les accompagneras dans l'utilisation de notre solution en assurant le traitement, le suivi et la résolution de leurs demandes. Tu auras aussi un rôle clé dans le pilotage de l'activité support, en interne comme auprès des clients.

Tu auras pour mission de :

  • Qualifier et traiter les demandes entrantes (outil de ticketing, e-mail) dans le respect des SLA (anomalies, demandes de support utilisateur, demandes d'évolution, demandes de travaux).

  • Vérifier la complétude des tickets (informations nécessaires, pièces jointes, contexte).

  • Réaliser le diagnostic des incidents (N1/N2) afin de déterminer la nature du besoin.

  • Prendre en charge et résoudre les demandes ne nécessitant ni paramétrage technique ni développement informatique.

  • Assurer la résolution des incidents ou leur escalade vers les équipes Produit ou Tech si nécessaire, en garantissant un transfert clair et documenté.

  • Assurer le suivi des demandes de bout en bout, informer régulièrement les clients et documenter chaque étape.

  • Veiller au respect des niveaux de service (SLA) et relancer les équipes de niveau 2 et 3 si nécessaire.

  • Formaliser la base de connaissances (FAQ, guides, tutoriels) et structurer les macros de réponse.

  • Participer aux tests et aux recettes des nouvelles versions et remonter les retours clients pertinents à l'équipe Produit.

  • Piloter l'activité support : prioriser et suivre les tickets de l'équipe, assurer le reporting et proposer des plans d'amélioration.

  • Animer les points réguliers avec certains clients (mensuels, trimestriels ou annuels) pour présenter le bilan du support sur la période.

Les outils et environnements de travail :

  • Utilisation basique de Base de données (via phpMyAdmin).

  • Maîtrise de Mantis (gestion des tickets).

  • Utilisation de base documentaire et procédures internes.


Ce qu'on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu es diplômé(e) d'une formation Bac+2 à Bac+3 (informatique de gestion, gestion de projet, école d'ingénieur ou équivalent).

description:
WHY this position is important

Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it.

The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is Autopilot: automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible.

These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production.

HOW you will contribute

You will join the ML & AI team, within a Tech organisation of more than 400 people. You will work on one main topic for the whole internship, protected from day-to-day work, with a dedicated tutor.

Every topic follows the same path:

  • Evaluation first: in the first weeks, you agree with your tutor on a frozen evaluation set and the metrics that matter.

  • A baseline in production: you ship a simpler first version that the team can put into production, around months 1 to 3.

  • Then go further: you improve it and explore more advanced approaches. Research topics are designed to lead to a publishable result.

You will own the topic end to end: understanding the problem with accountants and product teams, defining success metrics, building, measuring and presenting your results.

Topics for 2027

Here is an overview of the topics we want to staff in 2027. We agree on the final topic and your tutor with you.

  • Reading invoices and new types of documents with compact vision-language models (VLMs): fine-tuning, supervision from e-invoices, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

  • Knowing when the AI is right: calibrated confidence, selective automation and model routing for automated accounting decisions.

  • Evaluating accounting agents: an open benchmark of long-horizon accounting tasks on simulated client files, with verifiable scoring.

  • Learning from accountants' corrections: turning feedback into editable rules, with non-regression guarantees.

  • Bank reconciliation: matching one transaction to several documents, as learned graph optimisation.

  • An AI agent for Autopilot support tickets: from investigation to a pull request. This is an applied topic for profiles who prefer building systems close to production.

  • Data foundations for AI: evaluation datasets, data quality and monitoring, and agents that let teams query and use data on their own.

AI will be part of how you work

You will use coding assistants and AI agents every day: to explore the codebase and data models, write Python and SQL, run experiments, write tests and debug.

We expect you to give agents the right context and to check their output. You own the result, not the agent.

OUR CULTURE

You will join a hands-on engineering culture, where two technical co-founders are still among the most active contributors to the codebase.

You will work with ML and AI engineers, data specialists, software engineers, product managers and accountants. You will have strong mentorship and a lot of ownership: freedom to test ideas, challenge existing approaches and build things from scratch, with an R&D mindset.

The goal is not a demo. It is something the team can trust, reuse and ship.

YOU'RE THE RIGHT CANDIDATE IF YOU

  • Are in the final year of a Master's degree or engineering school in machine learning, computer science, statistics or applied mathematics. Research internships of at least 4 months are also considered.

  • Have strong ML foundations and solid Python, and have already trained, fine-tuned or evaluated models in academic, personal or professional projects.

  • Care about evaluation: clean baselines, reproducible experiments and metrics that reflect the real problem.

  • Are comfortable with real-world data: SQL, analysis, messy and imbalanced datasets.

  • Already use AI ambitiously in your projects and can explain how you verify its output.

  • Communicate clearly and enjoy working in a multidisciplinary team. No accounting knowledge is required, only curiosity.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

  • Duration: 5 to 6 months (final-year internship).

  • Start date: March or April 2027.

  • Location: Paris office, at least 3 days per week on site, together with your tutor.

  • Supervision: a dedicated tutor from the ML & AI team.

  • Resources: GPUs, API access to frontier models, real data under GDPR-compliant conditions, and our existing evaluation infrastructure.

  • After the internship: an opportunity to join Pennylane full-time on a permanent contract.

HOW TO APPLY

Please send us:

  • Your CV.

  • Links to relevant projects: GitHub repositories, technical reports, notebooks or papers.

  • A few lines on your motivation and the topics that interest you most.

title: Strategy & Operations Analyst
description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1200 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1,250,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 

Our electronic invoicing track represents a core strategic priority for Pennylane. This dedicated team is responsible for developing our comprehensive electronic invoicing offering for our accounting firm partners and their SME clients (Small and Medium-sized Enterprises), accelerating client acquisition, enhancing customer satisfaction, and establishing operational excellence within this segment.

 

As our cross-functional initiatives expand, we now require robust frameworks for end-to-end process management, data-driven performance analytics, and a relentless focus on operational efficiency and scalability. We are seeking an exceptional, impact-oriented Strategy & Operations professional who will be instrumental in building these critical capabilities and propelling our electronic invoicing track toward market leadership.

 

Why this role matters at Pennylane

 

The Strategy & Operations role will serve as the critical link between our strategic vision and day-to-day execution, working directly with the General Manager for the track. You will help translate ambitious goals into actionable, measurable roadmaps, establish best-in-class metrics, and develop the operational infrastructure needed to scale the business rapidly and sustainably.

 

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with significant opportunity for leadership and professional growth. 

 

Your responsibilities

 

Strategic planning and execution

- Partner with the product leadership to define, prioritize, and implement operational roadmaps aligned with business objectives

- Design and establish scalable operational frameworks that support our growth

 

Data-driven decision making

- Lead comprehensive analyses to identify market opportunities, operational inefficiencies, and growth levers

- Develop actionable insights and recommendations based on quantitative and qualitative research

 

Project leadership

- Spearhead strategic initiatives and pilot programs from ideation through implementation and measurement

- Identify and manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

 

Cross-functional orchestration

- Serve as the operational nexus between the track and horizontal teams including care, sales, and the other product teams impacted by the electronic invoicing reform

- Facilitate effective collaboration and alignment across organizational boundaries

 

Performance management

- Own the OKR process for the track, ensuring clarity of objectives and accountability for results

- Design and implement robust tracking mechanisms to monitor performance against key metrics

- Proactively identify performance gaps and develop action plans to address them

 

Who we’re looking for

 

Experience

- 5+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations or a related field, with a strong record of scaling business operations in dynamic environments

- Proven track record of translating strategic initiatives into executable operational plans and projects, delivering measurable business impact

- Proficiency in SQL (or willingness to learn) and modern data analysis tools to drive decision-making independently

 

Core competencies

- Strategic vision: ability to connect business objectives with operational requirements while maintaining focus on long-term goals

- Analytical excellence: skilled at distilling complex data into actionable insights that drive business outcomes

- Project management rigor: experience leading cross-functional initiatives from conception to implementation

- Communication and influence: exceptional ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuade diverse stakeholders

- Problem-solving orientation: demonstrated ability to identify root causes and develop innovative, practical solutions

⚠️ This role is Paris-based only, and unfortunately we're not able to offer a fully remote setup.

You'll need to be fluent in both French and English for this role.

Recruitment Process

- Screening interview with Barbara - Senior Recruiter (30 mins)

- An interview with Antoine - General Manager RFE (1h)

- A Business Case to prepare at home and to present (1h)

- A final interview with Eric - VP Strategic Initiatives (45 mins)

 

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

title: Growth Manager
description:
Who we are

Yubo is the instantly social, social app: the leading real-time social discovery platform where you can meet new people for friendship, crushes and community. Our mission is to help young adults find community - whoever they are, wherever they are and whenever they feel social. That's why we’re building a more spontaneous and human social world, one based on interaction, exploration and possibility.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission.

As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

We also work closely with the broader technology industry to share our knowledge and NGOs create industry-leading child protection standards.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

Growth at Yubo moves fast, and we don’t plan on stopping anytime soon ! More channels, more markets, more experiments to run, and we need brains (and hands…) to make it happen. We're bringing in a third Growth Manager to grow the team's capacity and add a perspective on Gen Z that comes from living it, being molded by it.

Sounds like you? You’ll like what comes next.

We’ll get you started by getting hands-on with every channel we operate, learning how each and every single one of them works before claiming your own piece of the portfolio. From there, a whole new world of possibilities opens up: push creative testing further, chase down new partners, help us uncover growth where we haven't looked yet, and more.

You'll work shoulder to shoulder with the rest of the Growth team (that includes Creative), Product, and Data, all pulling in the same direction. If you want a role where your instincts, ideas, and results speak for themselves, this is it.

Your responsibilites

  • User Acquisition & Paid Media Optimization: Manage and optimize a significant performance marketing budget across key acquisitoin channels, programmatic networks & emerging platforms. Scale acquisition and reactivation across multiple countries. Improve media buying, targeting, and creative to boost ROAS, using incrementality tests and attribution models. Help deploy automation and AI tools.

  • Creative Optimization: Collaborate with the creative team to ideate, produce and scale creative concepts that resonate with our Gen Z audience. Own creative testing and iteration to improve the scale, efficiency and longevity of winning ideas.

  • Growth Marketing: Support a multi-channel strategy that combines paid and brand marketing to drive organic, viral and referral loops. Contribute to ASO and lifecycle marketing to boost retention and monetization.

  • Data-Driven Growth: Partner with Product, Data, and Engineering to optimize funnels. Build dashboards and A/B testing processes. Stay ahead of privacy and adtech trends (e.g SKAN, AdAttributionKit).

  • Collaboration: Work with senior growth team members, share best practices, and foster a culture of experimentation and data-driven decisions.

Tools we use

  • MMP: Adjust

  • Analytics & dataviz: Amplitude

  • Market intelligence: Sensor Tower and Creative Ad Libraries

  • Acquisition channels: TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, Google Ads, Apple Ads

  • Programmatic networks: AppLovin, Moloco

Who you are

  • You have around 3 years of solid, consolidated experience in growth marketing or user acquisition for a B2C consumer app.

  • You have a genuine, native affinity with Gen Z culture and what makes it tick.

  • You have experience or a strong connection with the US market, whether through studies or product marketing experience.

  • You've scaled growth investment on at least one major social media platform and know how to read the results.

  • You know how to collaborate with creative teams: identifying what works, and clearly explaining why.

  • You have experience working with a martech stack, including custom audiences, conversion APIs, and MMP & SDK implementations and updates.

  • You're autonomous, result-oriented, and bring strong business acumen to your decisions.

Within a month, you will

  • Get to know Yubo's product, mission, and the Growth team's ways of working.

  • Meet your key stakeholders across Growth, Creative, Product, and Data.

  • Get onboarded on our tools and marketing stack, including Adjust, Amplitude and more

  • Start learning how each of our acquisition channels currently operates.

Within 3 months, you will

  • Fully own a portfolio of channels and campaigns to optimise in line with our performance guidelines

  • Work to automate campaign and creative optimisation process

  • Improve our usage of custom audience strategies across all channels

Within 6 months, you will

  • Scale your portfolio to reach our strategic growth objectives

  • Seek opportunities to further improve our growth operations by deploying AI tools

  • Assist in developing our retargeting workflows for a more diversified approach

The recruitment process

  • First call with Nicolas, Talent Acquisition

  • An interview with Janos, our Growth Director

  • Technical test / case study.

  • Fit interviews

  • And if everything goes well, an offer !

What we offer

  • A highly competitive salary range as well as equity in the company

  • A highly flexible remote work policy, 2 days at the office per month, with monthly team events.

  • We also cover fees for external professional events and meetups (Android Makers, etc…)

  • Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

  • Numerous benefits for parents: additional parental leave, easy access to nurseries and daycare facilities in France.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

 

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits:

Cool Workplace: enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

Team Activities: participate in get-togethers, events, and team-building activities

title: Senior Account Executive, Payments
description:
Account Executive, Payments (Existing Merchants)

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might be in the right place!

We are looking for an Account Executive, Payments, who is responsible for driving the adoption of Lightspeed Payments within Lightspeed's existing merchant base in France. This is a dedicated cross-sell/upsell position focused on transitioning current Point of Sale (POS) customers to our proprietary, integrated payment processing solution.

Lightspeed Payments has been continually invested into since launch in 2019, integrating a number of unique value drivers into the combined POS-payments solution. Building off of success our new business teams have experienced in selling the combined POS-payments solution, we are scaling our ability to sell payments into our existing merchant base, many of which became clients before we scaled Lightspeed Payments.

This position reports to the Global Payments Sales Manager and is part of the Global Payments GTM team.

Your Mission

The primary responsibility is to meet and exceed sales targets for Lightspeed Payments adoption among existing merchants.

  • Pipeline Management: Generate and manage sales opportunities using leads sourced from Account Managers, direct phone/email outreach, and follow-up on company-led marketing campaigns.

  • Sales Execution: Manage the complete sales cycle from initial qualification and value presentation through pricing negotiation and contract closure.

  • Customer Launch: Partner with Onboarding teams to ensure a smooth transition and launch for merchants adopting Lightspeed Payments.

  • Internal Expertise: Serve as the internal Subject Matter Expert (SME) on payment processing for other units, providing guidance and training as required.

  • Product Feedback: Collect and relay merchant feedback regarding the payments product to the Product Management teams.

  • Reporting: Maintain accurate records of all sales activities, pipeline status, and opportunity notes in Salesforce.com.

  • Other Duties: Handle additional duties and responsibilities as defined by management.

What you’ll be bringing to the team

  • Payments Experience: Direct experience (3+ years) in the payment processing industry.

  • Sales Closing Role: Demonstrated experience (3+ years) in a closing role focused on technology or solution sales.

  • Opportunity Development: Proven ability to proactively generate and qualify new opportunities.

  • Target Achievement: Documented history of success in a revenue target or quota-based environment.

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. French language skills are considered an asset.

What’s in it for you?

  • Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding

  • Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing as you are

  • An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact

  • Fun activities with your teammates & social events throughout the year

  • Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story

... and further

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health

  • Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform

  • People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Transit benefit if you travel by public transport to the office

  • Lunch reimbursement on the days you work from our Paris office

  • Healthy snacks and after work organized by the company

  • Health insurance with attractive guarantee plans

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

Warum Ovivamed?
Bei Oviva und Ovivamed Clinic verfolgen wir die Mission, nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu machen, während wir Europas führende KI-gestützte Plattform für die Behandlung chronischer Krankheiten aufbauen. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen in den Griff zu bekommen. Dabei konzentrieren wir uns auf das, was am wichtigsten ist: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Bis heute haben wir über eine Million Menschen in Grossbritannien, der Schweiz und Deutschland unterstützt. Hinter unserer Mission steht ein engagiertes Team, das in vier Ländern tätig ist, einschliesslich unseres Hubs in Polen. Jedes Gespräch, jede Coaching-Session und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher.

Die Rolle

Als Stellvertretende Ärztliche Leitung verbindest du die direkte Arbeit mit Patient:innen mit klinischer Verantwortung. Rund 60% deiner Zeit verbringst du in Konsultationen, in denen du Patient:innen auf ihrem Weg begleitest. microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors.

You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them.

This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage.

What You Will Do

  • Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why.

  • Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree.

  • Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room.

  • Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets.

  • Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy.

  • Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured.

  • Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result.

Requirements

  • You have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale.

  • Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today.

  • You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer.

  • You have led engineers: hired them, grown them, and kept a team shipping through 0-to-1 ambiguity. Typically 6+ years in hardware, but we care more about what you shipped than how long it took.

  • A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly.

  • Experience taking hardware to small-batch production: DFM, vendor and EMS management, test, and certification.

  • Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. A 0-to-1 hardware program takes the hours it takes, in person and at pace, and you have chosen that before.

  • Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

Nice to Have

  • Wearables, smartwatches, drones, robotics, AR/VR, or defense wearables on your résumé.

  • Camera systems: sensor selection, MIPI and ISP pipelines, and multi-camera synchronization.

  • Low-power and battery design, BLE or Wi-Fi, and antenna integration in small enclosures.

  • Enough mechanical fluency (CAD, tolerances, and materials) to challenge the mechanical team’s choices and be right some of the time.

  • Prior founder or founding-engineer experience, including the parts that went wrong.

  • Open-source hardware or firmware contributions.

title: End-of-Line Robotics Engineer
description:
You want to help build Europe’s resilience? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure?

You want to work at the frontier of high-performance autonomous systems?

Join CDDS and take ownership of our robotic End-of-Line test station, ensuring reliable and thorough validation of every drone.

CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones, including Mavics, FPV racers, and fast fixed wings. Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while countering threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments.

Tasks

Your mission

We are looking for an exceptional End-of-Line Robotics Engineer to take ownership of the automated stations that check every produced drone before it flies.

These checks span very different fields: propulsion, sensors, calibration, radio links, power and structure. You will be at the heart of our quality control: understand how a drone can fail, find the best way to detect it, and turn that into a reliable validation test on the production line.

You will work closely with our R&D and production teams, with the autonomy to shape the test architecture and the responsibility to prove it on the line. We are looking for rigour, curiosity and the persistence to follow a defect from its first symptom to a test that catches it every time.

Core responsibilities

  • Explore different ways to detect each drone defect, choose what to measure and set pass/fail criteria based on data.

  • Design and maintain the test software framework: sequencing tests, driving instruments and robots, logging results and linking every measurement to a drone's serial number.

  • Program handling routines for our collaborative robot and integrate them safely with fixtures and sensors.

  • Move proven tests into the Calibration & Validation room, make them robust for daily use by operators, and improve cycle time, coverage and uptime as volumes grow.

  • Analyse results across the fleet, spot trends and drifts, and report defects to design and production so they are fixed at the source.

Requirements

Your profile

You combine strong engineering and analytical skills with solid software craft. You break complex problems down, reason from data rather than assumptions, and enjoy getting a station working hands-on, not only in code.

  • At least 2 years in test engineering, validation, test automation or production test, ideally on robotic or electromechanical products.

  • Solid robotics fundamentals: modelling system dynamics, choosing sensors and actuators: understanding their trade-offs (noise, bias, bandwidth, cost).

  • Comfortable with reference frames and transforms: relating to IMU, camera and robot or vehicle frames, and how their data is fused together.

  • General knowledge of state estimation and control theory (e.g. Kalman filtering, PID and feedback loops), enough to understand how a drone or robot behaves and why a test result looks the way it does.

  • Strong Python (or similar) for test automation, hardware control and data analysis; comfortable on Linux. And tools such as Docker, Github etc...

  • Experience interfacing software with hardware over common protocols: serial/Ethernet devices, DAQ, sensors.

  • MSc or PhD in robotics, mechatronics, computer science, electronics or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

Nice-to-have

  • Classic computer vision and image processing (e.g. OpenCV): camera calibration, feature detection, measuring and inspecting parts from images.

  • Signal processing on test data: filtering, FFT and vibration analysis, anomaly detection on time series.

  • Programming collaborative robots, such as the Fairino FR5 or an equivalent (UR, Doosan, ABB GoFa…), and ROS/ROS 2.

  • Drone or UAV testing: autopilots (PX4/ArduPilot), telemetry and flight log analysis.

  • Deep knowledge of one or more embedded sensor (IMU, magnetometer, barometer, GNSS, cameras), their typical failure modes and calibration methods (e.g. camera–IMU).

  • Test data infrastructure: databases (SQL, time-series), dashboards (e.g. Grafana), traceability systems.

  • Experience in a regulated industry.

  • Reading or writing C/C++ for firmware and embedded tools.

Benefits

Why CDDS

  • Direct impact on a mission-critical technology shaping Europe’s security landscape.

  • Fast-moving startup environment with high ownership.

  • Work with a highly technical, ambitious, and hands-on team.

  • Real-world testing, deployments, and customer demonstrations.

  • Attractive compensation.

Details

Location: Zürich Hardbrücke, on-site
Start date: ASAP
Environment: High-impact deep-tech startup working on real deployments

title: Executive Assistant
description:
This is Cradle

Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools.

Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia.

We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across three offices in Amsterdam, Boston, and Zurich, alongside a few remote colleagues.

We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities.

The Role

As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care.

Responsibilities

  • Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email.

  • Own the inbox front line: Triage, draft and reply on their behalf to customers, investors, candidates and the team, so the important things surface and the rest gets handled.

  • Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side.

  • Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks.

  • Prepare every important meeting: Make sure briefs and context are ready beforehand, and follow up on decisions and action items afterwards.

  • Make recurring admin disappear: Automate repeated processes so they mostly run themselves.

Requirements

The best people we've hired didn't match a checklist. Below is a list of what matters most for this role. If you bring most of it and are curious about the rest, we'd love to hear from you:

  • 4+ years supporting senior executives, ideally more than one at a time

  • Sharp judgment about what's urgent, what can wait and what never needs to reach the exec

  • Clear, polished written English

  • You spot the next problem before anyone asks and fix it

  • Experience handling personal admin alongside the professional side, with the discretion that comes with it

  • Organised and dependable without needing a rigid structure; at a ~90-person company you'll often build the process yourself

  • At home in Google Workspace and quick to pick up new software tools

Nice to Haves

These aren't requirements, but they'd give you a head start:

  • German fluency would be ideal to make local appointments, paperwork and authorities much easier

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

  • Familiarity with Swiss administrative procedures (permits, insurance, tax paperwork, relocations)

  • Experience with task tools like Todoist, Notion or Linear

Our commitment to inclusive hiring

Cradle evaluates all candidates based on merit, regardless of sex, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic background, or any other aspect of identity. We maintain zero tolerance for discrimination and actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

AI disclosure

Cradle uses an applicant tracking system that includes basic AI-assisted features which may generate scores or rankings based on how applications match a job description. These outputs are not used to make or meaningfully influence hiring decisions — all candidates are evaluated through a thorough, human-led review by our recruiting team.

A notice about recruitment scams

Please be aware that scammers are posing as us in order to get your personal details or money. We only communicate via @cradle.bio email addresses, we only make job offers after having met you in person at our office in Zurich or Amsterdam, and we never ask you to pay for anything during the interview process.

title: Internship - 3D Graphics for Robotics
description:
Opening

WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP


Details

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: full-time (5 days/week)

Period: 6 months


About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Our core expertise lies in 3D vision and graphics technologies which we deploy in a dual-use context for inspection and defence. This role will initially focus mainly on the defence context where we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Our solutions are aimed to operate with low-cost and widely available sensors and compute. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics, and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners, low TRL research with government agencies, to direct collaboration with military units. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.


Your role

You will work in our team of experienced 3D computer graphics engineers, 3D vision engineers, and robotics engineers. You will not just work on some unimportant side project, but you might actually build key parts of solutions that will be used by our customers and partners. At Fiducial, graphics is not just about pretty pictures: our rendering, simulation, and GPU pipelines sit directly at the heart of our perception and autonomy systems. Activities include:

  • Building physically-based and multi-spectral rendering and simulation pipelines (e.g. EO and thermal/IR camera simulation) to generate realistic synthetic imagery and test perception algorithms across environments and conditions

  • Developing real-time 3D visualization and flight-analysis tools for inspecting reconstructed 3D flight paths, live sensor data, multi-camera detections, and point clouds

  • Working on real-time 3D reconstruction and novel rendering representations such as Gaussian splatting and multi-camera / LiDAR point-cloud mapping

  • Building real-time terrain and satellite rendering pipelines that run directly in the loop with our visual positioning and navigation algorithms

  • Writing and optimizing GPU compute and rendering workloads (shaders, CUDA, and low-level graphics APIs) to run efficiently on both desktop and low-cost embedded hardware

What we expect from you

  • Experience with real-time software development such as game, rendering, simulation, or embedded development

  • Solid grasp of 3D computer graphics fundamentals (rendering pipelines, 3D math and transforms, shaders, ray/path tracing, or rasterization)

  • Experience with graphics or GPU compute APIs (such as OpenGL, Vulkan, WebGPU/WGSL, DirectX, or CUDA)

  • Experience with 3D scene representations or reconstruction techniques such as meshes, voxels, point clouds, or Gaussian splatting

  • Experience with modern C++ (experience with Rust is also welcome)

Big plus if you’re strong in 3D computer vision. Because our graphics work is tightly coupled with our perception stack, strong vision fundamentals will let you have an even bigger impact:

  • Familiarity with camera models, projective and epipolar geometry, camera calibration, or PnP, which is useful when matching simulated or rendered views directly to real cameras

  • Experience with 3D reconstruction or mapping pipelines such as COLMAP, photogrammetry, Structure-from-Motion (SfM), SLAM, or visual odometry

  • Interest or experience in applying rendering and GPU compute to vision problems like long-range drone detection, satellite-to-camera matching, or depth estimation

General

  • Full-time availability during the internship period.

  • A willingness to pick up and learn new concepts quickly and to self-acquire missing background knowledge.

  • A high degree of autonomy, determination and grit in making cool tech work.

What can we offer

  • 1000 euro monthly compensation.

  • 10 vacation days during internship period.

  • (Really) flexible working hours and option to work from home 2 days per week.

  • Have a direct and significant influence on highly innovative products.

  • The opportunity to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops, close to the product. We are innovating, learning is to be expected.

  • Responsibility over the things you implement, you are the expert on what you build.

The application procedure

  • If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself; this can be a resume, website or other source, as long as we get a clear impression of your background and skills.

  • We’ll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we’ll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a technical focused interview could follow.

  • If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we’ll discuss the specifics (starting date and period).

  • Welcome to the team!

title: Productmanager - Team Sellers
description:
Onderaannemers ontvangen stapels offerteaanvragen, elk met honderden tekeningen, een bestek en een hoeveelhedenstaat. Veel uitzoekwerk dus, en lang niet elke aanvraag levert uiteindelijk werk op. Dat zien we terug in elk land waar we actief zijn, van Nederland tot Denemarken. Bij 12Build ben jij eigenaar van het product dat daar verandering in brengt.

We zoeken een AI-native productmanager voor Team Sellers, het team dat 12Build bouwt voor onderaannemers en leveranciers. Je hebt een goed gevoel voor product, voelt je thuis in data en werkt al dagelijks met AI-agents. Bovenal ben je graag bij klanten en werk je graag met mensen. Zo doen we productwerk bij 12Build.

Het team en de uitdaging
Team Sellers bestaat uit jou, een productdesigner, een lead developer en developers die samen met agents werken. Jij, de designer en de lead developer sturen het team samen aan als trio. Je bedient twee doelgroepen. Onderaannemers gebruiken 12Build om offerteaanvragen van hoofdaannemers te vinden, te beoordelen en erop te reageren. Leveranciers, de fabrikanten en groothandels in bouwmaterialen, gebruiken het om vroeg in projecten te komen en hun partners te bereiken. Leveranciers zijn een relatief nieuwe doelgroep voor ons, dus er valt nog veel te ontdekken.

Er is genoeg op te lossen. Onderaannemers zijn uren bezig met de vraag welke aanvragen het opstellen van een offerte waard zijn. De informatie die ze nodig hebben, zit verspreid over documenten, e-mails en telefoontjes met de hoofdaannemer. En ze willen zien wat het platform hun oplevert. AI verandert wat we voor onderaannemers en leveranciers kunnen bouwen, en jij bepaalt mee waar het het meeste verschil maakt.

Hoe we werken
12Build werkt sinds 2026 AI-first. Designers, developers en PM’s werken allemaal met agents, en we verbeteren die workflows continu om de weg van klantsignaal naar release korter te maken. Die manier van werken is nog lang niet af, en als PM heb je veel invloed op waar het naartoe gaat.

Een paar voorbeelden van waar we nu staan:

  • Onze bedrijfskennis staat in één gedeelde repository, de brain, waar mensen en agents allebei mee werken.

  • PM’s werken met Claude, gekoppeld aan tools als Amplitude, HubSpot, Linear en Slack.

  • Een wekelijkse signal radar verzamelt klantsignalen uit die bronnen en zet ze om in Linear-issues, met het bewijs erbij.



De PM bepaalt wat we bouwen en waarom. Agents nemen elke maand meer onderzoek, analyse en eerste versies over. De tijd die dat oplevert, gaat naar het werk dat alleen mensen kunnen doen: met klanten praten, relaties opbouwen en iedereen achter één richting krijgen. Samen met de PM’s van Team Buyers en Team Growth bepaal je welke workflow we als volgende verbeteren.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bouwt een heldere visie op waar het product voor onderaannemers en leveranciers de komende jaren naartoe gaat, en vertaalt die naar een strategie en roadmap. Die richting stem je af met de andere productteams, Commerce, Sales en Marketing, zodat het platform als geheel werkt.

  • Je bent een groot deel van je week bij onderaannemers en leveranciers en bouwt een netwerk op van klanten die met je meedenken.

  • Je managet je stakeholders. Je houdt het management en de commerciële teams op de hoogte, weegt verzoeken die botsen tegen elkaar af en legt helder uit waarom iets wel of niet op de roadmap staat.

  • Je bepaalt met je trio welke problemen we oplossen en in welke volgorde. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor waarde en haalbaarheid: gaan klanten het gebruiken en ervoor betalen, en werkt het voor sales, marketing en customer success?

  • Je legt vooraf vast wanneer iets een succes is en meet dat daarna. Onze data-analisten ondersteunen je bij de diepere analyses. Zelf denk je in data: je leest een funnel of een retentiecurve en weet welke vraag je daarna stelt.

  • Samen met de designer werk je toe naar een heldere oplossing. De developers maken er issues van en bouwen het, en jij checkt of wat live gaat het probleem oplost waarmee je begon.

  • Je verbetert hoe het team met agents werkt. Je bouwt en onderhoudt skills, prompts en checks, en deelt wat werkt met de andere teams.

  • Je werkt met Product Marketing en Commerce aan positionering, packaging en lanceringen.


Over 12Build
Al bijna twintig jaar verbindt 12Build hoofdaannemers, onderaannemers en leveranciers. We zijn marktleider in Nederland en actief in België, Duitsland en Denemarken. Sinds januari 2026 zijn we onderdeel van de E1-groep, samen met EstimateOne en C-Link. Ongeveer honderd collega’s werken vanuit twee kantoren en vanuit huis, verspreid over Europa, met een gezonde dosis Drive, Openness en Happiness.

Sven’s tip for new 12Builders:

“Finding your own style and using it to inspire your colleagues is strongly encouraged!”


Werken bij 12Build, durf jij het aan? 


Wat breng je mee?

  • Minimaal vier jaar ervaring in B2B SaaS en een goed gevoel voor product. Dat kan als productmanager, of in een aanverwante rol van waaruit je de stap wilt maken. Eerdere ervaring met een marktplaats of een workflowproduct met veel documenten is een plus.

  • Je hebt eerder een productvisie en -strategie opgesteld en de mensen om je heen erin meegekregen.

  • Je kunt goed met mensen. Je bouwt snel vertrouwen op bij klanten en collega’s, luistert goed en brengt mensen met verschillende belangen samen achter één richting.

  • Technisch begrip. Je hebt nauw samengewerkt met developers, kent de gangbare termen en praat op niveau mee in een discussie met de lead developer.

  • Je denkt in data. Je voelt je thuis in productanalyse (Amplitude of vergelijkbaar), je kunt een experiment opzetten en je weet wanneer een getal te zwak is om een besluit op te baseren.

  • Praktijkervaring met agentic werken. Je gebruikt tools als Claude of Codex voor meer dan chatten, je hebt eigen workflows of skills gebouwd en je kunt ons er een laten zien. Je inspireert collega’s om anders te werken.

  • Je beoordeelt kritisch wat agents opleveren en staat achter wat onder jouw naam live gaat.

  • Je maakt je een nieuw domein snel eigen. Ervaring in de bouw helpt. Nieuwsgierigheid ernaar is een must.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.


Wat bieden we?

  • Je kiest je eigen hardware: Windows, Mac of Linux.

  • Je werkt thuis en op kantoor. Voor de thuiswerkdagen krijg je een thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Elke dag een gratis lunch op kantoor.

  • Een cultuur waar we echt in investeren, met teamdagen, uitjes, sprekers en workshops.

  • Een platte organisatie met korte lijnen.

Heb je nog vragen of twijfel je nog een beetje? Geen probleem! Stuur gerust een e-mail naar Niels (Recruiter, Instagram of               

Tot snel!

title: QA Engineer (EN)
description:
About the role

At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. You think along before any code is written, test smartly where it matters, and act as the bridge between development, product and the rest of the company when it comes to quality. You report to the Teamlead Frontend and work daily with the frontend, mobile and backend teams.

What you'll do

  • Think along from the start. You join refinements and help teams see the risks and impact of a feature before they start building;

  • Choose the right test approach. Together with the team, you decide per feature what to test automatically, what to test manually, and why;

  • Build and maintain automated tests. You set up tests for key platform functionality and keep them reliable;

  • Manual and exploratory testing. You go through the app yourself, look for edge cases and find what a script misses;

  • Central point of contact for bugs. Bug reports from across the company come to you. You reproduce them, gather all the information a developer needs to get started, and get them ready in Jira with the right priority;

  • Advise on releases. You map out risks and give clear advice on the quality of a release;

  • Provide insight. You collect test data and show how our software quality is doing;

  • Keep the balance. You help teams weigh fixing bugs against building new features.

What you bring

  • A bachelor's level of working and thinking, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field;

  • At least 2 years of work experience, including at least 1 year as a QA Engineer, Software Tester or Test Automation Engineer;

  • Experience setting up and carrying out a test approach and test plans;

  • Experience with test automation and test frameworks;

  • You're comfortable working with AI tools and use them purposefully: to test faster and better, and to set up automated tests;

  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum team and with a bug tracking system, preferably Jira.

  • You work independently, make decisions in your own work and give advice, whether asked or not;

  • You're critical and analytical, take initiative and work well with developers, product and business.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and you're comfortable working with code;

  • You look beyond "does it work?": also at accessibility, speed, security and multilingual support.

  • Experience with tests that run automatically on every code change, and you know how to deal with unreliable tests;

  • You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues test better;

  • Experience testing mobile apps.

We're looking for someone who sees quality as something the whole team owns. You don't just perfect your own testing work; you ask yourself what needs to change structurally so the whole team tests better. Our own values guide the way: Own it, Say it, Make it.

What we offer

title: Digital Channel Manager (Kiosk)
description:
Wil jij werken voor een fantastisch merk waar je direct impact kunt maken? Ben jij een digital marketing professional met een passie voor food en retail, en voel jij je thuis in een internationale omgeving? Dan is dit jouw kans.

Wat is jouw bijdrage aan het succes van KFC?
Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het commerciële succes en de continue optimalisatie van het kiosk-kanaal van KFC Nederland. Met behulp van data-analyse, klantinzichten en nauwe samenwerking met verschillende teams zorg je voor meer gebruik van de kiosken, hogere omzet, betere conversie en een hogere gemiddelde besteding per gast.

Jouw volgende uitdaging begint hier

Als Digital Channel Manager (Kiosk) maak je deel uit van het Digital Team van KFC en speel je een belangrijke rol in onze digitale toekomst. Jij bent de drijvende kracht achter de commerciële prestaties en voortdurende optimalisatie van onze self-service kiosken in de restaurants.

Je pakt nieuwe zaken snel op, bent nieuwsgierig van aard en weet klant- en prestatiegegevens moeiteloos te vertalen naar heldere acties en verbeteringen.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bent eigenaar van één van KFC's belangrijkste digitale verkoopkanalen en hét aanspreekpunt voor alles rondom de kiosken. Je monitort en verbetert het gebruik, de omzet, conversie en de gemiddelde besteding per gast.

  • Je creëert een eenvoudige, snelle en intuïtieve klantreis, terwijl je tegelijkertijd zorgt voor gebruiksgemak voor onze restaurantteams.

  • Je stelt business requirements op, coördineert testtrajecten en ondersteunt de implementatie van verbeteringen aan de kiosken in samenwerking met het regionale productteam, IT, Operations en technologiepartners.

  • Je signaleert kansen om prestaties te verbeteren door dashboards te monitoren en nauw samen te werken met Commercial Finance. Inzichten vertaal je naar concrete acties.

  • Je verhoogt de conversie door middel van A/B-testen, analyses van klantgedrag en continue optimalisatie van de kiosk-ervaring en productpresentatie.

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat campagnes, producten en waardeproposities effectief worden gepresenteerd en correct worden gelanceerd op de kiosken. Daarbij optimaliseer je de menustructuur, productzichtbaarheid en upsell- en cross-sellmogelijkheden.

  • Je houdt platformproblemen in de gaten en werkt samen met IT en technologiepartners om deze op te lossen.

  • Je werkt intensief samen met Operations om het gebruik van de kiosken en de uitvoering in de restaurants te verbeteren. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met collega's van Digital, Brand, Innovation, IT, Commercial en externe partners.

Over KFC Nederland

Kentucky Fried Chicken, de Amerikaanse restaurantketen gespecialiseerd in fried chicken, is sinds 1972 actief in Nederland. Inmiddels telt Nederland 96 KFC-restaurants. Dagelijks bereiden onze chefs verse kip- en vegetarische gerechten volgens het originele recept uit 1939 van oprichter Colonel Harland Sanders. Naast de focus op onze producten en de verdere groei van ons restaurantnetwerk, investeren we volop in de ontwikkeling van onze medewerkers.


Wat breng jij mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Marketing, Bedrijfskunde, Digital Commerce of een vergelijkbare richting is een pré, aangevuld met minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring in het beheren of optimaliseren van een digitaal klantkanaal.

  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en ervaring met het monitoren van dashboards, het vertalen van data naar inzichten en acties, en het uitvoeren van A/B-testen.

  • Ervaring met het verbeteren van klantreizen, digitale interfaces en online merchandising.

  • Sterke projectmanagement- en stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden, met het vermogen om mensen te beïnvloeden zonder hiërarchische verantwoordelijkheid.

  • Een gestructureerde, proactieve en hands-on werkstijl, gecombineerd met een pragmatische en samenwerkingsgerichte aanpak.

  • Nieuwsgierigheid en de drive om continu te testen, leren en verbeteren.

  • Ervaring binnen restaurants, retail of QSR (Quick Service Restaurants) is een pré.

  • Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen? Geen probleem!

Onderzoek laat zien dat mensen vaak pas solliciteren wanneer zij aan vrijwel alle functie-eisen voldoen. Bij Collins Foods kijken we niet alleen naar ervaring, maar ook naar potentieel en ambitie.

Word jij enthousiast van deze rol? Dan horen we graag van je. Misschien ben jij precies het talent dat wij zoeken.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij ons krijg je de kans om echt impact te maken binnen een internationale, dynamische en groeiende organisatie. Je komt terecht in een hecht team waar initiatief, ondernemerschap en creativiteit worden gewaardeerd én verwacht.

Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

  • Veel vrijheid om je rol vorm te geven en jouw ideeën werkelijkheid te maken.

  • Vanaf dag één verantwoordelijkheid en eigenaarschap.

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring.

  • Een prestatiegerichte bonusregeling.

  • Uitgebreide mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

  • Een uitstekende pensioenregeling.

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

  • 8% vakantiegeld.

  • 27 vakantiedagen.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Personeelskorting op KFC-producten en deelname aan bedrijfsfitnessprogramma's.

  • Mogelijkheid om hybride te werken.

Klaar om impact te maken?

Zie jij jezelf in deze rol en wil jij meebouwen aan de digitale toekomst van KFC? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog. We kijken ernaar uit om je te ontmoeten!
